response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a long track record across web, mobile, and systems programming, and even relevant geospatial domain experience via GISCollective/Green Map. However, his recent and primary professional experience is overwhelmingly in JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js web development, with C++ limited to a single short stint nearly a decade ago and no evident Rust experience. The role requires deep, current C++/Rust expertise for building production routing pipelines, which is not reflected in his recent work history.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience through GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong generalist engineering background across many languages and paradigms (DLang, C++, Java, low-latency systems at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated ability to learn new stacks quickly and work across the full technical stack, aligning with the 'willingness to expand expertise' requirement
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (2014-2015 role only), with no recent hands-on use
No mention of Rust experience at all
Current and recent roles (re:cinq, Optilyz, RIDE) are almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js product/web work, not systems-level or performance-critical pipeline engineering

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/current C++ or Rust expertise
Recent career trajectory focused on web/product engineering rather than systems/pipeline engineering
